title: Parquet/DuckDB pivot — the twelve-lane warehouse and its serving path
note: Chartered retroactively 2026-08-23: waves 1-3 already shipped (RUNBOOK 0.21-0.29) with no track, so the largest workstream in the repo was tracked only in prose. This records wave 4. The owner call behind it all is RUNBOOK 0.28/plantgeo-parquet-duckdb-pivot: Postgres keeps ONLY community features, every plane becomes day-partitioned Parquet on Railway storage read by DuckDB+Polars, Martin serves PMTiles. Map breakage during the transition is accepted.
shipped_before_this_track: Twelve lanes with validation, serving and forecasters (abf777f)
Lane natures, watermark-driven static lanes, conformed calendar dimension (b794e98)
Per-kind schema lookup, unblocking the five forecasters (269d299)
Zoom axis end to end + soil-survey streaming export, cap deleted (68da7af)
wave_4_scope: DONE ceeb2c9/3b7ecfb: sub-day version fix + the orphan-part blocker its review found
DONE fe32aef: conductor decisions -- zoom axis, Postgres demoted to a cut-off
DONE 68da7af: zoom= partition key, uniform z0/z5/z9/z13 ladder, soil-survey streaming export (cap DELETED)
A. Tier derivation z9/z5/z0 from base z13 in Polars/DuckDB -- BLOCKS everything visual
B. Bulk Postgres drain (13,037 lane-days, 69% fire-detections), then stop the cron
C. interface/http serving API -- coverage must REPRODUCE getSliderCapabilities' contract
D. Next.js repoint of the six ready tRPC procedures
E. Forward path per lane: upstream API -> Parquet, deprecate that lane's Postgres source
F. New lanes: soil-field (has none), Open-Meteo ensemble/flood/CAMS, fire-risk feature plane
G. Static lookups leave the lane registry (soil-survey, watersheds); needs its own coverage check

partitions.note: HYPOTHESIS -- re-verify every owns list with a real grep if HEAD has moved past 68da7af. The z0-z4 slices from the previous set all SHIPPED in 68da7af; this is the next wave. d1 (tier derivation) blocks anything visual: the ladder exists but only its top rung has data, so serving at z0/z5/z9 honestly returns empty until it lands. d2 (drain) and d1 are independent. d3 depends on d1 for coarse tiers to be servable, but its endpoints can be built against the base tier first.

slices.task: Derive zoom tiers z9/z5/z0 from the base z13 Parquet in Polars/DuckDB. Geometry generalization per ladder step. NEVER from the Postgres matviews.
Bulk Postgres -> Parquet drain as ONE focused job writing the new zoom layout. Delete the old-layout objects. Order: build, run, THEN stop the cron.

interface/http serving API over the twelve planes: per-day, window, as-of, coverage. bbox pushdown, zoom routing, four-state envelope. Coverage REPRODUCES getSliderCapabilities' shape and stays whole-warehouse.
Repoint the six ready tRPC procedures onto parquet-plane-client.ts: drought, water-gauges, weather-observations, signal, vegetation, fire-detections. NOT soil-survey or burn-severity (no data yet).
soil-field lane: zoom-tiered, sourced from agri.spatial_cell, has NO lane today. signal_plane_day_export.sql exports cell_id with no cell geometry.

open_decisions: Half-written release reads as `current`: completion marker (adds a 3rd object kind) vs a resolve_static_lane rule that a day whose last export raised must re-export (cheaper, stays in the contract module). See RUNBOOK 0.33.2.
AGRI_DATA_SERVICE_URL and AGRI_PARQUET_SERVICE_URL both point at one service, deliberately (different failure policies). Collapsible at parquet-plane-client.ts:54.
